chat.purchase.review.en: Review the purchase below. Confirm signs the purchase preference on the simulated device and only then prepares the approval card; simulated SMS verification and a final approval follow before anything is done.
chat.purchase.review.zh-CN: 请核对下面的申购要素。点「确认」后，模拟设备会签署申购偏好，然后才生成审批卡；之后还需短信验证（模拟）与最终确认才会办理。

chat.purchase.product.en: Which product would you like to buy? Name it here (options below), or compare and choose on the wealth page.
chat.purchase.product.zh-CN: 您想申购哪一款？可以直接说产品名称（可选产品见下方），或在理财页比较后选择。

chat.purchase.amount.en: How much would you like to buy? Name an exact amount, such as CNY 2,000.
chat.purchase.amount.zh-CN: 您想申购多少金额？请说一个明确的金额，例如“2000元”。

chat.purchase.both.en: Which product, and how much? Name both here (options below), or choose on the wealth page.
chat.purchase.both.zh-CN: 您想申购哪一款、多少金额？可以直接说产品名称和金额（可选产品见下方），或在理财页选择。

chat.purchase.deictic.en: 'That one' refers to a product seen on the wealth page, which the chat cannot identify. Name the product, or choose it on the wealth page.
chat.purchase.deictic.zh-CN: “那只 / 这款”指的是理财页上看到的产品，对话里无法确定是哪一款。请直接说产品名称，或在理财页选择。

chat.purchase.title.en: Purchase to review (awaiting your confirmation on the simulated device; the approval card follows)
chat.purchase.title.zh-CN: 申购要素（待您在模拟设备上确认，确认后才生成审批卡）

chat.purchase.objective_line.en: Comparison objective: {objective} (other preferences as on the wealth page)
chat.purchase.objective_line.zh-CN: 比较目标：{objective}（其余偏好与理财页相同）

chat.redeem.none.en: You hold no position that can be redeemed.
chat.redeem.none.zh-CN: 您目前没有可赎回的持仓。

chat.redeem.choose.en: You hold several positions. Say which one to redeem, or choose it on the wealth page.
chat.redeem.choose.zh-CN: 您有多笔持仓，请说明要赎回哪一笔，或在理财页选择。

chat.subscription.choose.en: Choose the debit authorization to cancel. A cancellation card follows, and nothing is cancelled until you confirm it on the simulated device.
chat.subscription.choose.zh-CN: 请选择要取消的代扣授权。选中后会生成取消卡片，在模拟设备上确认之前不会取消。

chat.subscription.no_match.en: No debit authorization matches the amount or merchant you named. Choose the one to cancel below.
chat.subscription.no_match.zh-CN: 没有找到与您说的金额或商户相符的代扣授权。请从下面选择要取消的那一项。

chat.subscription.none.en: There is no debit authorization to cancel; nothing was done.
chat.subscription.none.zh-CN: 当前没有可取消的代扣授权，没有办理任何业务。

chat.schedule_cancel.choose.en: This message started no new payment and created no new card. Existing scheduled transfer authorizations have not been cancelled: choose the one to cancel below. A revocation card follows, and the result is shown after you confirm it on the simulated device.
chat.schedule_cancel.choose.zh-CN: 这条消息没有发起新付款，也没有生成新卡片。已有的定时转账授权尚未取消：请从下面选择要取消的那一项，选中后会生成撤销卡片，在模拟设备上确认后显示撤销结果。

chat.schedule_cancel.none.en: This message started no new payment and created no new card. You have no active scheduled transfer authorization.
chat.schedule_cancel.none.zh-CN: 这条消息没有发起新付款，也没有生成新卡片。您目前没有进行中的定时转账授权。

chat.schedule_cancel.done.en: The remaining runs of this scheduled transfer authorization were revoked; transfers that already ran are not undone.
chat.schedule_cancel.done.zh-CN: 已撤销这项定时转账授权的剩余执行；已经执行的转账不会撤销。

chat.redeem.no_match.en: You hold no position in the product you named. Say which holding to redeem, or choose it on the wealth page.
chat.redeem.no_match.zh-CN: 没有找到您说的那款产品的持仓。请说明要赎回哪一笔，或在理财页选择。

chat.purchase.access_line.en: Access to the money: within {days} days
chat.purchase.access_line.zh-CN: 取用等待：不超过 {days} 天

chat.purchase.objective_line_full.en: Comparison objective: {objective} (every term above is signed by the confirm gesture)
chat.purchase.objective_line_full.zh-CN: 比较目标：{objective}（以上各项都会在点「确认」时签署）

chat.purchase.changed.en: The purchase terms changed after you reviewed them, so nothing was signed. Restate the purchase and review the new terms before confirming.
chat.purchase.changed.zh-CN: 申购要素在您核对之后有变化，没有签署任何内容。请重新说明申购要求，核对新的要素后再确认。

chat.mood_hold.en: This reads as a question, a supposition or something that already happened, so nothing was prepared and no card was created. To do it now, say the request directly.
chat.mood_hold.zh-CN: 这句话是在询问、假设或说明已经发生的事，没有办理这项业务，也没有生成卡片。如需现在办理，请直接说要办理的业务。

chat.time_hold.wealth.en: Purchases and redemptions cannot be scheduled in chat: your words named a time, so no purchase review or redemption card was prepared. To do it now, restate it without the time, or use the wealth page.
chat.time_hold.wealth.zh-CN: 对话里还不能预约申购或赎回：您的话里提到了时间，所以没有生成申购要素或赎回卡片。如需现在办理，请去掉时间后重新说，或到理财页办理。

chat.time_hold.subscription.en: A subscription can only be cancelled now in chat: your words named a time, so no cancellation card was prepared. To cancel now, restate it without the time, or use the subscriptions page.
chat.time_hold.subscription.zh-CN: 取消订阅在对话里只能马上办理：您的话里提到了时间，所以没有生成取消卡片。如需现在取消，请去掉时间后重新说，或到订阅页办理。

chat.redeem.quantity.en: Say the amount to redeem, or say 'redeem all'. No redemption card is prepared until the quantity is clear.
chat.redeem.quantity.zh-CN: 请说明要赎回的金额，或说“全部赎回”。在说清数量之前不会生成赎回卡片。

chat.redeem.quantity_over.en: That amount is more than can be redeemed. Name an amount within it, or say 'redeem all'.
chat.redeem.quantity_over.zh-CN: 您说的金额超过了可赎回的数额。请说一个不超过它的金额，或说“全部赎回”。
